Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-02
DOC-0035 2026-10-12
MEETING NOTES — Electrical and Avionics Desks Divide
the Afternoon
Date: 2026-10-12
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0028 for TEAM-0004; partner team's desk
coordinator; station roster clerk; queue chair.
Purpose: Agree afternoon desk coverage at DEMO-STATION-02. The
electrical discussion folder is located through ISSUE-0082 and
TASK-0216; TASK-0218 remains a separate attachment reference.
Decisions
TEAM-0004 will hold electrical coordination from 14:00 to
18:00. The partner team's desk will hold avionics during that
interval. These are desk coverage responsibilities, with task
assignments remaining a separate records matter.
A request spanning both headings goes to the queue chair for a
primary contact. Preserve the secondary question on the same
dated sheet and name the role that will answer it. The primary
contact remains responsible for arranging the next
conversation even when another desk supplies background.
The roster will show subsystem, covered interval, receiving
role, and fallback contact. The station clerk will keep the
previous roster beside any revised copy so an appointment
change remains traceable.
Action items
_ Owner: PERSON-0028. Due: 2026-10-12 at 13:30. Confirm the
electrical receiving role and fallback on the roster.
_ owner: Partner desk coordinator. Due: 2026-10-12 at 13:30.
Confirm the avionics interval.
D. Worker 0028
Demo Worker 0028, Demo Team 04
